description: This file contains unit tests for the JpegSizeLimiter class, testing its ability to compress images within size constraints and maintaining image properties.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for JpegSizeLimiter, verifying compression logic under different payload size conditions.

methods.name: compressesLargePayloadsUnderLimit
methods.description: Tests that large payloads are compressed such that their size is within the specified limit, and image properties are adjusted accordingly.

methods.name: keepsSmallPayloadsAsIs
methods.description: Tests that small payloads are left unchanged with correct image properties when already below size limit.
